The '''Dolla system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was the location of a major [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] staging area. [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Jedselk]] held office in the Dolla system after being promoted from the position of [[Planetary Governor/Legends|planetary governor]] of [[Sellasas]].<ref name="GG10" />
